## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] New saved fields are tidied in `src/model.mjs`, with a test
- [ ] Works in Simple and in Advanced; switching modes loses nothing
- [ ] No network requests, outside scripts or copyrighted hymn texts added
- [ ] Screenshots at phone and desktop width for visible changes
